parameters.query:
select state, data::text as data,
       (extract(epoch from updated_at) * 1000)::bigint as updated_at
  from bot_sessions
 where chat_id = $1;

-- Phase 4b: the lookup and the availability check read Postgres, not Sheets.
-- Column aliases reproduce the sheet's headers exactly, so brain.js consumes
-- this the way it consumed the Sheets node and needs no change.
--
-- bookings_live, NOT bookings_model, and the reason matters. The model folds a
-- guest's continuation lines into one booking, which is right for a report and
-- wrong here: this feeds the EDIT path, which writes back to a sheet row by
-- number. Offer مروان as one 2200 row and the next payment lands on line 22
-- while line 23 still holds its 1600 — the sheet would double-count. So this
-- stays line-for-line with the sheet, exactly as the Sheets node was: all 55
-- lines, cancelled ones included, because findConflicts() skips those by their
-- ملغي note and the edit flow can still reach them.
--
-- '=OPEN' is deliberate. An open-ended stay arrived from the FORMULA read as
-- '=TODAY()-J5', and both findConflicts() and showValue() key off that leading
-- '='. Keeping the sentinel keeps that contract; Phase 5 replaces it with the
-- open_ended boolean and deletes the sniffing.
select
  b.sheet_row                                          as row_number,
  coalesce(b.booking_ref, '')                          as "بوكنج ID",
  coalesce(b.guest_ref, '')                            as "ID",
  coalesce(b.guest_name, '')                           as "اسم المقيم",
  coalesce(b.booking_type, '')                         as "نوع الحجز",
  coalesce(b.phone, '')                                as "رقم الهاتف",
  coalesce(b.apartment_name, '')                       as "اسم الشقة",
  coalesce(b.room_number, '')                          as "رقم الغرفة",
  case when b.open_ended then '=OPEN'
       else coalesce(b.effective_nights::text, '') end as "عدد الليالي",
  coalesce(to_char(b.arrival, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '')       as "تاريخ البداية",
  coalesce(to_char(b.departure, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '')     as "تاريخ المغادرة",
  coalesce(trim(to_char(b.effective_total, 'FM999999999.##')), '')     as "اجمالي سعر الحجز",
  coalesce(trim(to_char(b.paid, 'FM999999999.##')), '')                as "اجمالي ما تم دفعه",
  coalesce(b.payment_method, '')                       as "طريقة الدفع",
  coalesce(trim(to_char(b.effective_remaining, 'FM999999999.##')), '') as "المتبقي",
  coalesce(b.notes, '')                                as "ملاحظات",
  -- Everything below is for the payment path, and none of it is a sheet column.
  -- brain.js reads these by their ASCII names; the Arabic aliases above are the
  -- cells, these are facts about the booking.
  b.id                                                 as booking_id,
  -- A booking occupies one row per payment METHOD. A payment in a method that
  -- is already here joins that row and its cell grows; only a method not yet on
  -- the booking opens a new one. Without this the bot could only ever see the
  -- booking's own row, so a second method overwrote the first — reported live
  -- on 2026-08-14.
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            'seq', l.line_seq, 'row', l.sheet_row, 'method', l.method,
            'amount', coalesce(pay.amount, 0)) order by l.line_seq), '[]'::jsonb)
     from booking_lines l
     join lateral (select coalesce(sum(p.amount), 0) as amount
                     from payments p
                    where p.booking_id = l.booking_id
                      and p.line_seq = l.line_seq) pay on true
    where l.booking_id = b.id and l.sheet_row is not null) as lines,
  -- The last sheet row this booking occupies. A new line is inserted directly
  -- under it, which is where a person would put it.
  greatest(b.sheet_row, coalesce((select max(l.sheet_row) from booking_lines l
                                   where l.booking_id = b.id), 0)) as block_end,
  -- Whether اجمالي سعر الحجز on this row is a live formula (`=650*I18`, a
  -- nightly rate). If it is, the booking row's total is the sheet's and must not
  -- be reduced when a line is split off — writing a scalar there would destroy
  -- the rate. Same rule mirror.py applies through sheet_owned_keys.
  (b.nightly_rate is not null)                         as total_is_formula
from bookings_live b
order by b.sheet_row;

-- The apartment/room registry, seeded from the الإتاحة tab and verified equal
-- to it on 2026-08-09: 6 apartments, 26 rooms on both sides.
--
-- Aliases match the tab's own header row, so locationRegistry() reads this
-- exactly as it read the Sheets node. Rooms sort numerically rather than by
-- text, or room 10 would sit before room 2 on the keyboard.
select
  a.name   as "الشقة",
  r.number as "الغرفة"
from rooms r
join apartments a on a.id = r.apartment_id
where r.active and a.active
order by a.id, length(r.number), r.number;

insert into bot_sessions (chat_id, state, data, updated_at)
values ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, now())
on conflict (chat_id) do update
   set state = excluded.state,
       data = excluded.data,
       updated_at = now();

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const gid = $('Config').first().json.BOOKINGS_SHEET_GID; if (gid === undefined || gid === null || String(gid).trim() === '') throw new Error('BOOKINGS_SHEET_GID is not set — refusing to insert a row into an unknown tab'); return JSON.stringify({ requests: [{ insertDimension: { range: { sheetId: Number(gid), dimension: 'ROWS', startIndex: $('Brain').first().json.save.row - 1, endIndex: $('Brain').first().json.save.row }, inheritFromBefore: true } }] }); })() }}

parameters.query:
insert into bot_sessions (chat_id, state, data, updated_at)
values ($1, '', $2::jsonb, now())
on conflict (chat_id) do update
   set state = '',
       data = excluded.data,
       updated_at = now();

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ requests: [{ repeatCell: { range: { sheetId: Number($('Config').first().json.BOOKINGS_SHEET_GID), startRowIndex: $('Brain').first().json.save.row - 1, endRowIndex: Math.max($('Brain').first().json.save.row, Number($('Brain').first().json.save.formatThrough) || $('Brain').first().json.save.row), startColumnIndex: 0, endColumnIndex: 21 }, cell: { userEnteredFormat: { backgroundColor: { red: 0, green: 0, blue: 0 }, textFormat: { foregroundColor: { red: 1, green: 1, blue: 1 } } } }, fields: 'userEnteredFormat(backgroundColor,textFormat)' } }] }) }}

parameters.query: =select sheet_row as row_number, id::text as "معرف النظام" from bookings where sheet_row = {{ $('Build Shadow Write').first().json.sheet_row }} and {{ ['booking','edit','cancel'].includes($('Build Shadow Write').first().json.flow) }};
select * from reconcile_bookings order by sheet_row;

-- Bookings the database has and the spreadsheet does not.
--
-- Everything the web UI creates lands here: it writes Postgres directly, so
-- until something appends a row the booking is invisible to the sheet, to the
-- 1,606 formulas in the other nine tabs, and to the daily report.
--
-- Column names are the sheet's own headers, so the Google Sheets node maps them
-- by name; `booking_id` carries the id through for the update that follows and
-- matches no header, so it is ignored on the way in.
--
-- `mirrored_at is null` is the guard against appending the same booking every
-- morning. `mirrored_at` is the marker rather than sheet_row because it is what
-- makes the query idempotent — a booking already published must not be picked
-- up again tomorrow. The row itself IS computed here (see row_number below) and
-- written back by `Mark Mirrored`; the older note saying otherwise described an
-- append this branch stopped doing.
--
-- Formulas use INDIRECT("I"&ROW()) rather than the I{row} the bot writes, for
-- the same reason: nothing here knows the row number yet, and ROW() does.
select
  b.id                                             as booking_id,
  -- The row to write, computed here rather than appended.
  --
  -- Google's append writes a FULL-WIDTH row, blanking every column the mapping
  -- does not mention — which would wipe the per-row formulas in N نسبة البرنامج,
  -- P المتبقي, R تاريخ الإدخال and S صافي الدخل on the row it lands on. (K
  -- survives an append because it is an array formula; the others are not.)
  -- Updating a known row touches only the mapped columns, which is why the
  -- bot's own booking writes have never damaged them.
  --
  -- The last row is taken across ALL THREE tables that remember one, not from
  -- `bookings` alone. A continuation line's row lives in `booking_lines`, so a
  -- booking on row 96 with its انستاباي line on 97 made `max(bookings)` answer
  -- 96 — and the next mirrored booking would have been written straight over
  -- row 97, which is somebody's money.
  --
  -- This is still the DATABASE's belief about the sheet, not the sheet's own
  -- last row: a row typed by hand below everything the database knows is
  -- invisible here. `reindex.py --apply` adopts such a row and is what makes
  -- the two agree again; run it before trusting this branch after any hand
  -- editing. The bot's own append asks the sheet directly, which is the
  -- stronger answer and the one to move to if this ever writes over a row
  -- again.
  (select coalesce(max(r.sheet_row), 1) from (
     select sheet_row from bookings
     union all select sheet_row from payments
     union all select sheet_row from booking_lines
   ) r)
    + row_number() over (order by b.id)            as row_number,
  coalesce(nullif(b.booking_ref, ''), '')          as "بوكنج ID",
  case when b.guest_ref is null or b.guest_ref = '' then ''
       else '''' || b.guest_ref end                as "ID",
  coalesce(b.guest_name, '')                       as "اسم المقيم",
  coalesce(b.booking_type, '')                     as "نوع الحجز",
  case when b.phone is null or b.phone = '' then ''
       else '''' || b.phone end                    as "رقم الهاتف",
  coalesce(b.apartment_name, '')                   as "اسم الشقة",
  coalesce(b.room_number, '')                      as "رقم الغرفة",
  case when b.open_ended then '=TODAY()-INDIRECT("J"&ROW())'
       else coalesce(b.nights::text, '') end       as "عدد الليالي",
  coalesce(to_char(b.arrival, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '')   as "تاريخ البداية",
  case when b.open_ended and b.nightly_rate is not null
         then '=' || trim(to_char(b.nightly_rate, 'FM999999999.##'))
              || '*INDIRECT("I"&ROW())'
       else coalesce(trim(to_char(b.total, 'FM999999999.##')), '') end
                                                   as "اجمالي سعر الحجز",
  coalesce(trim(to_char(b.paid, 'FM999999999.##')), '') as "اجمالي ما تم دفعه",
  coalesce(b.payment_method, '')                   as "طريقة الدفع",
  coalesce(b.notes, '')                            as "ملاحظات",
  b.id::text                                       as "معرف النظام"
from bookings b
where b.sheet_row is null
  and b.mirrored_at is null
  and b.cancelled_at is null
  -- The sheet has one paid cell, and "650 EGP + 40 USD" is not a number that
  -- fits in it. Left for a human, listed by mixed_currency_bookings.
  and not exists (
    select 1 from payments p
    where p.booking_id = b.id
    group by p.booking_id having count(distinct p.currency) > 1
  )
order by b.id;
update bookings set mirrored_at = now(), sheet_row = {{ $json.row_number }} where id = {{ $json.booking_id }};
